India Condemns Demolition of Historic Gurdwara in Pakistan

A 125-year-old Sikh Gurdwara in Farooqabad, Pakistani Punjab, was demolished. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned the act as a "targeted act of vandalism" and "deeply distressing." New Delhi expressed concern over the lack of action by local authorities and the Evacuee Trust Property Board, demanding a prompt investigation and restoration. The demolition sparked protests from the Sikh community, and the Chief Minister of Punjab, Maryam Nawaz, took notice of the matter.
